scope: Static read-only review of the root-authored UI, API, pure query module and WebMCP hook before imported application data was available. No browser or shared-file write was performed.

findings.finding: Nullish-coalescing defaults accept explicitly present null values for property, direction and page. The WebMCP schema declares typed fields, and present invalid fields must reject rather than become defaults.
findings.required_change: Default only when the property is undefined; reject null and every other wrong type.

findings.finding: RelationObservation.field_presence types statement_id as string, while the frozen import interface requires statement_id, qualifiers and references to be booleans.
findings.required_change: Use boolean for statement_id and verify the imported observation shape in focused checks.

findings.finding: The fallback text combines a missing qualifiers field and a present-but-empty qualifier container, contrary to the explicit missing-versus-empty display requirement.
findings.required_change: Pair each raw statement with its field_presence record or Object.hasOwn and render distinct missing, supplied-empty, and supplied-with-values states.

findings.finding: The expandable observation detail shows date, entity revision, raw statement and response hash but does not expose the retained requested_url.
findings.required_change: Display or link the exact dated request URL in the observation provenance detail.

aligned_static_behavior: Incident edges retain their original source and target; direction filtering does not reverse rows.
The list displays the original property label and property ID, and P460 gets explicit non-equivalence wording.
The diagram is bounded to six incoming and six outgoing edges from the current page and states its shown/full counts; the complete page list follows.
The route rejects repeated and unknown URL parameters, emits controlled non-echoing errors, limits pages to 20 records in the pure query layer, and sets no-store on success and failure.
Concept finding reuses the existing same-origin concept-library API; neighbor, filter, pagination and WebMCP paths share the same selection callback and URL update.
The selected ConceptRecord exposes its existing resource links and pinned concept source record without merging edge labels into library labels.
No transitive closure, path proof, inverse predicate, inferred identity, or mathematical equivalence is computed.
next_review: After the findings are corrected and importer outputs are frozen, inspect only the delta plus whole-row fidelity, exact pagination/property/direction oracles, probe raw-field preservation, P518=Q9085982 display data, malformed API/tool inputs, URL/state consistency, and the canonical typecheck/build records.
